name: Admin — GIS analytics renders the map and the per-barangay table

planSteps.description: A map is rendered (a MapLibre canvas with MapTiler / OpenStreetMap attribution)
A table of barangays is shown, each row naming a barangay of Cabuyao and a report count
The barangay names shown are real Cabuyao barangays such as Marinig, Mamatid, Banlic or Butong
